iDEP: Identifying Differentially Expressed Genes

If this site has contributed to your work, please cite our article:

Ge, S.X., Son, E.W. & Yao, R. iDEP: an integrated web application for differential expression and pathway analysis of RNA-Seq data. BMC Bioinformatics 19, 534 (2018). https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-018-2486-6

Summary

Read Counts data were analyzed using iDEP v2.4.4. The data was first filtered to remove reads below 0.5 CPM in at least 1 sample. Then the data was transformed with EdgeR using a pseudocount of 4. Missing values were imputed using geneMedian.

After mapping, there are 32833 unique genes in 158 samples. Of the 24127 genes passed filter, 24127 were converted to Ensembl/STRING gene IDs in our database. The remaining 0 genes were kept in the data using original IDs.

Differential expression analysis was performed using DESeq2 with an FDR cutoff of 0.1 and a minimum fold-change threshold of 2. Standard Wald test was used and independent filtering was enabled.

# DESeq2 script generated by iDEP on Sun Jun 14 20:05:53 2026
# Please cite https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-018-2486-6

# R version 4.5.1 (2025-06-13)
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")  # v. 1.30.26
if (!require("DESeq2", quietly = TRUE))
  BiocManager::install("DESeq2")  # v. 1.48.2
library(DESeq2) # D.E.G.
FC <- 2 # Fold-change cutoff
FDR <- 0.1 # FDR cutoff
alpha <- 0.1 # independent filtering, default

#  Prepare data --------------------
# Use the "Converted counts" button in the Pre-Process tab
# to download the filtered counts file with gene IDs converted to Ensembl.
raw_counts = read.csv("converted_counts_data.csv")
row.names(raw_counts) <- raw_counts$User_ID
raw_counts <- raw_counts[, -(1:3)] # delete 3 columns of IDs
str(raw_counts)

# Factors coded: OSDID --> A, genotype --> B, Time_After_Treatment_min --> C, Radiation_Dose_cGy --> D

row.names(col_data) <- colnames(raw_counts)
col_data

#Set reference level 
col_data[, 2] <- as.factor(col_data[, 2])
col_data[, 2] <- relevel(col_data[, 2], "genotypeWILDTYPE")
col_data[, 3] <- as.factor(col_data[, 3])
col_data[, 3] <- relevel(col_data[, 3], "Time_After_Treatment_min10")
col_data[, 4] <- as.factor(col_data[, 4])
col_data[, 4] <- relevel(col_data[, 4], "Radiation_Dose_cGy10000")

# Run DESeq2--------------------
DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
   countData = raw_counts,
   colData = col_data,
   design = ~  B + C + D + A 
)
dds = DESeq2::DESeq(dds) 

# Extract results--------------------

# Comparison 1 of 15:  genotypeMYB3R135-genotypeWILDTYPE
res <- DESeq2::results(dds,
  contrast = c("B", "genotypeMYB3R135", "genotypeWILDTYPE"),
  independentFiltering = TRUE,
  alpha = alpha
)
# Examine results 
summary(res)
plotMA(res)
plotCounts(dds, gene = which.min(res$padj), intgroup = colnames(col_data)[2])
res <- subset(res, padj < FDR & abs(log2FoldChange) > log2(FC)) # Select
table(sign(res$log2FoldChange)) # N. of genes Down, Up
res <- res[order(-res$log2FoldChange), ] #sort
head(res) #top upregulated
tail(res) #top downregulated

# Comparison 2 of 15:  genotypeSOG11-genotypeWILDTYPE
res <- DESeq2::results(dds,
  contrast = c("B", "genotypeSOG11", "genotypeWILDTYPE"),
  independentFiltering = TRUE,
  alpha = alpha
)
# Examine results 
summary(res)
